## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

---

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature address? Is your feature request related to a frustration or limitation?

> e.g. "I'm always frustrated when I can't set multiple timers simultaneously..."

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like this feature to work. Be as specific as you can.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? List them here.

---

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
